destination.name: Batemans Bay
destination.tagline: Clyde River town on the Princes Highway, Canberra's nearest ocean beach.
destination.description: Batemans Bay is a town of about 16,000 where the Clyde River meets the Pacific, the closest ocean beach to Canberra. The surrounding coast and national parks are little developed. Visitors come for the beaches, a cruise up the Clyde and the village of Mogo, 9 km south, which has Mogo Wildlife Park.
whyVisit: See red pandas at Mogo Wildlife Park
Browse cafes and shops in Mogo
Look over the Clyde from Holmes Lookout

goodToKnow.title: Canberra road has tight bends
goodToKnow.detail: The Kings Highway from Canberra takes 2–2.5 hours and drops down Clyde Mountain with very tight 25 km/h corners.

goodToKnow.title: Summer doubles the population
goodToKnow.detail: Wikivoyage says the population more than doubles in summer, so beaches and roads are busy December to February.

goodToKnow.title: Zoo hours and price
goodToKnow.detail: Mogo Wildlife Park is open 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM, with adult entry listed at $42.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are warm and bring the holiday crowds, while autumn and spring stay mild.
